about: Dauphin is a city in west-central Manitoba on the Vermilion River, at the foot of Riding Mountain and in a mixed Ukrainian-settlement farm belt. A compact downtown, country-music festival tradition, and a role as the parkland’s northern service centre define the community. About 8,000 people live in Dauphin.
seoSummary: Parkland Manitoba city at the foot of Riding Mountain—Ukrainian-settlement farm belt and regional service centre.
